# PostMail

> PostMail is email tracking software for Gmail and Outlook. It tells you the exact moment a recipient opens your email or clicks a link, and sends real-time notifications so you can follow up while you're top of mind.

PostMail is aimed at salespeople, recruiters, and freelancers who send outbound email and need to know when it's been read.

## What it does
- Detects email opens in real time via an invisible tracking pixel (sub-second detection).
- Tracks clicks on individual links inside an email, per-link.
- Filters bot/proxy opens for accurate human-only metrics.
- Sends notifications via Discord webhook, Slack webhook, or browser push when an email is opened.
- Works as a Chrome extension inside Gmail compose, and via OAuth for Outlook — no separate app to check.
- Provides a web dashboard with open/click history, engagement heatmaps by day and hour, and per-thread engagement graphs.
- Offers a REST API and Zapier integration for connecting tracking events to other tools.

## Pricing
- Starter: $0/mo — 50 tracked emails/mo, 1 connected account, basic dashboard, 24h open history.
- Pro: normally $12/mo, currently free while PostMail is in public beta — unlimited tracking, 5 connected accounts, Discord & Slack notifications, link click tracking, 30-day analytics.
- Enterprise: custom pricing — SSO/SAML, dedicated account manager, custom API integrations, SLA, on-premise option.

## Privacy
Email content never touches PostMail's servers. Tracking pixels are stateless — only the open/click event is recorded. Connections are encrypted with TLS 1.3.
